# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.5.1

Version 1.5.1 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.5.0

**A new town is saved right after the talk with the first villager you meet.** On the first day the game only lets
you save once you have met a villager (the gyroid at your house refuses before that), and a new town has no file
until its first save. The autosave tried that first save every half minute, outdoors only (or when you went through a
door), so up to 30 seconds or more could pass after the talk, longer if you stayed in a building; had the game closed
or crashed meanwhile (an Android app swiped away, for example), the whole start was lost: the train ride, the names
and the house. Now the first save is made as soon as the talk is over, a few seconds later, wherever you are
(outdoors or in a building), and a notice says the town was saved.

**A new resident is saved from their first day too.** A player who moves into a town that already has a file was not
autosaved at all until Tom Nook's part-time job was over, unless they saved at the gyroid, even after meeting
villagers; the gyroid itself would have saved them. The autosave now follows the gyroid's rule: such a player is
saved, with the same notice, right after the talk with the first villager they meet, and from then on as usual.

- Nothing else changes: with the first save made, the autosave goes on every minute outdoors, between scenes and when
  you quit, as before. With the autosave turned off in the settings, nothing is saved by itself.
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.4.x's: v1.4.0 to v1.5.1 can be in the same room, and 32-bit and
  64-bit players can play together, whatever graphics API each uses.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.5.1-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 (Windows 10+) |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.5.1-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.5.1-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.0 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.5.1-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a); Vulkan on Android 7.0+ |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

Played by script on v1.5.0 and on this version (the game's frames are the same in every run; the autosave's own
timing goes by the clock):

- **A new town from the title screen** (the train, the names, Tom Nook, the house, the first villager): the villager
  remembers the player as the talk starts, and this version saves the new town file 2.6 s after that talk is over,
  with the notice, then every minute and on quitting as before. v1.5.0 makes the same save on its own half-minute
  round, which in this run happened to come right after the talk too.
- **A new resident on the first day** (a town that has a file, a player who has met a villager but never saved, with
  the part-time job on): v1.5.0 refused every autosave, on the timer and on quitting; this version saves at once, and
  a file it wrote then loads in v1.5.0 with its autosave working as usual.
- **A player whose job is over but whose house was never marked as saved** (autosaved by v1.5.0 or earlier): saved on
  the timer as before, and the house is now marked.
- Before the first villager, nothing is saved, as before (the gyroid's rule).
- An independent review of the change found one problem, fixed before this release: with that last kind of player,
  the first save could stay due and be written every frame.
- The 43 scripted scenarios run for every release give the same screenshots, logged positions and saves on v1.5.0
  and on this version (REGRESSION).
- All unit tests pass; the decomp change is inside `TARGET_PC` only and the matching build's hashes are unchanged.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.5.1, versionCode 10501).

## Known limitations

- The game itself still allows no save on the first day before you have met a villager; this is the gyroid's rule,
  kept as it is.
- The limitations of v1.5.0 remain (Vulkan and Direct3D 12 checked on software renderers only; see its
  [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.5.0)), and those of
  [v1.4.3](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.3).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
